description: A Python script to run multinode training with submitit, including argument parsing, shared folder setup, and job submission logic.

classes.name: Trainer
classes.description: A class to handle training setup, checkpointing, and GPU configuration for multinode training.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments, extending detection's argument parser.

methods.name: get_shared_folder
methods.description: Returns a shared folder Path based on environment, raising error if unavailable.

methods.name: get_init_file
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique init file path for distributed training.

methods.name: Trainer.__call__
methods.description: Runs detection.main with the stored arguments after setting up GPU args.

methods.name: Trainer.checkpoint
methods.description: Prepares a delayed submission for checkpointing, reusing existing checkpoint if available.

methods.name: Trainer._setup_gpu_args
methods.description: Configures GPU-related arguments based on the current job environment.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to set up and submit a multinode training job using submitit.
